{{Quote|Tokra Hazz sent many Baran Do Masters into hiding and thought about what to do next.''"<br />"''And ''what to do'' was to dig a hole in the ground.''"<br />"''Yes.|Chara and Ben, on the creation of the Hidden Ones|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
The '''Caverns of the Hidden One''' were a system of caverns deep below the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. They were home to the [[Hidden Ones]], a secret sect of the [[Baran Do]]&mdash;a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based organization on Dorin&mdash;dedicated to preserving the order's knowledge.

==History==
The caverns were first found and expanded by the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Baran Do]] Master [[Tokra Hazz]], shortly after the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Hazz feared that the Sages would be purged by the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] like the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and so secretly founded the [[Hidden Ones]], a secret sect of the Baran Do dedicated to preserving the knowledge of the Order, so that, if the Baran Do ever ''were'' destroyed, the Order could be reinstated. He became the sect's first leader, known as [[the Hidden One]], and probably created the tradition of the [[dying ceremony]] as a means of joining the sect.

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] the recently [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], arrived on Dorin, seeking to speak with Baran Do [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Master of the Order]] [[Koro Ziil]]. They eventually traveled to the Caverns of the Hidden One, and, after Luke [[Confrontation in the Caverns of the Hidden One|dueled]] with Koro Ziil, convinced the Hidden Ones to leave the caverns and return to the surface.
